name: Shidou Ayane
source:
[spoiler]Formerly working for a company with her brother, Ayane used to have a wonderful life. However, after a terrorist attack that murdered her brother, she seeks revenge and joins FLAK.[/spoiler] Because of her rage, she becomes a battle maniac when fighting.
